Body.Content:
Sellers can draft, review, and work their Dynamics 365 Sales account plans from Cowork. Sales Research Agent brings the same account-planning experience - objectives, targets, actions, and gaps grounded in CRM data - into the place sellers already work, and changes are saved to the plan in Dynamics 365 Sales.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: December CY2026
